newsitem.title: UK: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil firm.
newsitem.headline: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil firm.

text.p: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil was notionally firmer for most of the day but dealers said late losses on crude would have trimmed its gains.
A Russian cargo, sailing on the vessel "Blue Star,' was heard having been traded at $113.50 cif ARA. The same buyer also bought another Russian cargo on Tuesday at $111 cif.
Another trader was thought to be offering another Russian cargo at around $2 over the mean/mean of quotes.
One refiner said he thought demand for E-4 cargoes was sickly because published quotes were around $5 too high.
